steps.name: Dan
steps.text: The scorching sun, the wilds, the golden sand, and the warm breeze! Woohoo! I feel a new song coming on!

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: （solo）

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Could the both of you quiet down?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Please. It's not often we get such a peaceful environment with no one chasing us. Can't we just have a nice, quiet rest?

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: But Alty, I can smell the sea from here. Are you sure we're safe?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Aya, could you not spoil the mood for once?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Nowhere in the world is truly safe, but we have to learn to let ourselves relax sometimes.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Maybe you're right.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: So what's the next step? How are we going to broaden our path? We can't go back empty-handed.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: At least that doctor gave us an answer this time.
Alty looks at the 'key' in her hand.

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: Really? That looks like something special. And she just gave it to you? What did you trade for it?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Knowledge.

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: And was that a fair trade?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: I'm not sure. But I think that doctor wants us to put this knowledge to use.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Wouldn't she know?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: We know a lot, she should just...

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: ...If you think about it, the real trade was her using our curiosity to get us to act.

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: So, that means she didn't pay anything?

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: We've been cheated.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: More like baited.

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: Directed?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Guided.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Is that doctor really so important?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: No. I think she's trying to tell us that her actions have no impact at all.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: What matters is what we think and what we do.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Then what about the key? Should we go?

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: Ugh, this sucks. Could we not go?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: I'm thinking it's sort of like music... Our power should not be to force change onto others, we should just be singing our own songs.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Sing for them. If it sounds good—

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: Then they'll sing too.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: （solo）

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Hah, then we will give even more knowledge, and the key, over to the one who is ready.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: And who will that be?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Maybe they haven't been born yet.

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: That would be great!

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: No it wouldn't, Dan. We... hm?

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: What is it, Alty?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: The car's dead.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Didn't you prep it?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Yes, but we took that detour.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: And I have to admit, it's really easy to lose your heading in the middle of the wilderness with no roads or signs.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: So basically, we're lost?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: I'm not sure that's how I'd put it. It's not so much that we're off course as it is we're carving a new path.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: We're lost.

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: We're lost! That's a pretty good theme.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: You know, Dan, I really wish I could learn some of your optimism. So what are we going to do?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: It looks like there's a rainforest over that way. Let's check it out.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: So, who's getting out to push?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: We could take turns.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Alty.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: We've got a crowd here.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Yes, we do.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: But I don't know what language they're speaking.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: So should we just let them follow us?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Do you have a better idea?

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: We could kill them all?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: You think you can get Frost and Dan to go along with that?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: (Strumming and singing)

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: &*......%$ ....& (W-What is this sound? And why do I like it so much?!)

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: &%......% (I've never heard anything like it...)

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: Hey, how is everybody?!

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: Can you tell me what language you're speaking?!

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: Oh, but I guess even if you told me, I still wouldn't know.

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: ......%&$ (Where did they come from?!)

steps.name: Archosauria D
steps.text: $......&# (And why does this one look so weird?)

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Well, at least there are people here.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: I just hope there's a place we can resupply.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Wishful thinking.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You're outsiders?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Huh? You speak Sargonian?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Yes, it looks like you're definitely outsiders.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: What are you doing here?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Our car died, so we're looking for someone with the Arts to recharge it.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...Come with me.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: See, Aya, that was more than just wishful thinking.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Fine. I guess the world is a magical place.

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: Hey hey hey! What's this?!

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: There's a village here in the middle of this primeval forest!

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: (Humming)

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: It's really amazing. You can see the influence of modern architecture on most of the buildings, but they still have that primitive beauty.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: It's odd, but very special.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I am the leader of this tribe, Zumama. Most of my people can understand your language.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I can have some of our priests recharge your vehicle, but there are terms.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: What terms?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I want to look inside your vehicle, at its structure.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: ...Is that all?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Are you sure you won't break it?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I'm pretty sure.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Alty?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: It's not like we have a choice.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Agreed.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Good. High Priest...

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: I'm here! ...Oh?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Hmmmmm....?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: I know of you...

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: I know of you...

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: I never expected to see your kind here.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Oh, honestly, I was thinking the exact same thing.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: But I'm more interested in your vehicle than you!

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: By all means.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: I said it before and I'll say it again. The world is a magical place.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: I have to say, I agree.
At the same time, Frost hooks her guitar up to the ceremonial speaker and improvises a solo.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Nice, Frost.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: This village is inspiring me.

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: Awesome, Frost, you really switched up the melody this time.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Heat, repressed...

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: I'll call this song... 'D'!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Where's that sound coming from?

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: What is it?I can feel it energizing me!

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: It must be the outsiders who just came! Let's go see!

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: There are more of them, Alty...

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: That's not good.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: These lives thirst for music! For energy! For...

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: What a voice!

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: Outsider, give us more music!

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Alty... I know it's unexpected, but I think the atmosphere here is actually really good.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Why don't we get out the amps and play together?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: I guess that would be fine.

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: Yeah, can't let Frost take all the glory!

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: I gotta get in on such a badass track!

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Then let the locals feel the music of AUS!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: It's just a few notes, but I'm too excited to sit still!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: It might be like what the priests do, it's called 'music'?

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: I've never heard anything like it! Who are these people?!

steps.name: Archosauria D
steps.text: I know, they must be 'Cuicayotl'!

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: 'Cuicayotl'? What's that?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Oh, that's how you say 'one who sings' in their language.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: But it's been a long time since they had a 'Cuicayotl' here, and you've won them over with your music.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: And I must say, your music is vastly different from that of any other 'Cuicayotl' I've ever heard before!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: But no matter. I find yours a lot more fun!

steps.name: Archosauria E
steps.text: 'Cuicayotl', give us another song!

steps.name: Archosauria F
steps.text: I'll give you anything! Just one more song!

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: What do we do, Alty?

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: Let's stay here, Alty!

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Well, I can't let you forget our goal...

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: But, fine. We've got time.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: I never imagined there would be a Messenger here.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: And I never thought AUS, from all the magazine covers, would show up here either.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Where's Zumama?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: She's making the speaker system you asked for. So I'll be taking you.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: How long are you going to stay?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Maybe a week, maybe a month, maybe a whole year.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: This place is doing it for us. I think we can have some fun here, at least.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Then this is the right place for you to put on a show.

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: So cool!

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: It's... some kind of temple?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: That's right. This is where all the tribes used to gather for the 'Mahuizzotia', but it hasn't been used since Gavial left.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: 'Mahuizzotia'?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Gavial? That name came up at Rhodes Island... No, it's probably just a common name.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: You can perform here.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: We're going to give the people the best music they've ever heard.

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: Yes, hahaha! Yes! We'll leave the mark of AUS right here!
Two months later...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: AUS is unbelievable...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: They actually did stay for two whole months.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: If Gavial ever comes back, she's going to be blown away by the music we have way out here now.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: The people fell in love with their rock and roll.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: So what are they going to perform for us today?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: ...I wonder maybe if I'm their biggest fan.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: AUS...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Huh?
The room is empty. All the toiletries and bedding are neat and tidy, with a piece of paper resting on the table in the center.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: They're gone?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: There's a note on the table. Let's see...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: 'We left. Don't miss us. I hope you enjoyed the music. Also, we left all our records here for you. Have fun. -AUS'

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: ...Heh, they really are unbelievable.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: I don't think I'll ever forget that Acahualla place.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: (Humming) It was definitely unforgettable.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: But the people there are really noisy, and wild.

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: Yeah? I love them!

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Of course you do. I don't think you'd mind if we left you there.

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: I was definitely thinking about it.

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: Don't you think those people have a kind of natural, primal energy?

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: Out of all the countries and cities we've been to, I've never seen people like that.

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: I love 'em!

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Well, you're right about that much.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: They really get our music. They're the best audience we've ever had.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: I think Frost likes them too.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: But we can't just show up and flip a whole civilization upside-down. We should stick to singing.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Sing for them. If it sounds good—

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: Then they'll sing too.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Didn't we say that before?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Who knows? We might've said it a million times already.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Let's go. Continue on our journey.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: If we sing to the world, will she listen?
A few of the bandmates joke around for a bit, until the car goes silent.
Alty looks at the key in her hand, 'Dr. Kal'tsit, can that Rhodes Island of yours give the world the answer it's looking for?'
